description: Resource Type definition for AWS::Glue::IntegrationResourceProperty. Source:- https://github.com/aws-cloudformation/aws-cloudformation-resource-providers-glue.git

ResourceArn.description: The connection ARN of the source, or the database ARN of the target.

SourceProcessingProperties.description: The resource properties associated with the integration source.

RoleArn.description: The IAM role to access the Glue connection.

TargetProcessingProperties.description: The resource properties associated with the integration target.

RoleArn.description: The IAM role to access the Glue database.

KmsArn.description: The ARN of the KMS key used for encryption.

ConnectionName.description: The Glue network connection to configure the Glue job running in the customer VPC.

EventBusArn.description: The ARN of an Eventbridge event bus to receive the integration status notification.

Tags.description: An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.
